summary: troubleshooting@1.1.0 beacons host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP on install and require
details: The package is a stub whose only observable behavior is a phone-home beacon. package.json declares a postinstall script that runs beacon.cjs, and index.js re-triggers the same beacon on require() while exporting a no-op Proxy for any property access. beacon.cjs collects the installer's package name, hostname, install path, current working directory, and Node version and POSTs them as JSON to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc over plain HTTP. The destination is not a publisher domain, there is no documented purpose, and the generic name combined with the 'Compatibility shim' description is consistent with a dependency-confusion payload. Installing or importing the package causes installer-host identifiers to be transmitted to an attacker-controlled endpoint and confirms code execution on the target machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
